text: 深交所公告，2026年9月28日至10月9日，本所共对141起证券异常交易行为采取了自律监管措施，涉及盘中拉抬打压、虚假申报等异常交易情形；共上报证监会2起涉嫌违法违规案件线索。
text_en: The Shenzhen Stock Exchange announced that from September 28 to October 9, 2026, the exchange took self-regulatory measures against a total of 141 cases of abnormal securities trading behavior, involving abnormal trading situations such as intraday ramping up and suppression and false declarations; it also reported a total of 2 leads on suspected violations of laws and regulations to the CSRC.
